is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles stephensi (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study only reports bioassay results (WHO tube and CDC bottle) and does not perform any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data is reported; only mortality rates and lethal times from bioassays are provided (Table 1, Table 2).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from Chabahar port, Sistan and Baluchistan province, Iran (Page 1, Abstract).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study comparing two bioassay methods.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is tied to Chabahar port, Sistan and Baluchistan province (Page 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection/testing period is stated as 2015–2016 in Figure 2 and Figure 3 captions.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This appears to be an independent study of bioassay methodology in Iran.

supplement.evidence: All relevant bioassay data is contained within the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study compares the WHO standard susceptibility test with the CDC bottle bioassay for Anopheles stephensi collected in Chabahar, Iran. It reports mortality rates and lethal times (LT50/LT90) for DDT, bendiocarb, and deltamethrin, but does not include any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: The study was conducted in Iran, which is not an African country.
The study does not report genotyping of any target insecticide-resistance markers.
